_note: Maps each of the 15 model_info.json vision classes to its knowledge/chilli_kb.json entry (as 'section.id'). 'kb_ref' is null where no matching reference entry exists in knowledge/chilli_reference.txt — these classes get no KB-grounded advice and the chat layer falls back to its general (non-KB) reasoning for them.

Black Thrips.notes: Reference 'Thrips' entry (Scirtothrips dorsalis, Caliothrips indicus, Frankliniella sulphurea) covers chilli thrips generally; model class is specifically 'Black Thrips'. Telugu name reused 1:1 from model_info.json.

Anthracnose.notes: Reference 'Die-back and fruit rot' is caused by Colletotrichum capsici, the standard anthracnose pathogen of chilli.

Leaf Curl.notes: Reference 'Gemini virus' entry describes chilli leaf curl virus.

Healthy.notes: Not a pest/disease/deficiency — no KB entry expected.

Leaf Spot.notes: Reference document only describes one 'leaf spot' disease entity (Xanthomonas campestris pv. vesicatoria). Model's 'Leaf Spot' class name is generic/unspecified; mapped to Bacterial Leaf Spot for consistency with app.py's to_core_class(), which already routes generic 'spot' labels to bacterial_leaf_spot. FLAGGED for review — could also be a fungal leaf spot not covered by this reference.

Mosaic Virus.notes: Model class is generic 'Mosaic Virus'; reference document's only mosaic-virus entry is Cucumber Mosaic Virus (CMV), the most common cause of mosaic symptoms in chilli per the source. Peanut Bud Necrosis Virus (also in the reference) causes necrotic ring/streak symptoms, not mosaic, so it was not used here.

Gall Midge.notes: Reference 'Chilli Flower Midge' (Asphondylia capsici) is the same insect as 'Gall Midge'.

Fruit Borer.notes: Mapped to the Helicoverpa armigera component of the reference's combined 'Pod Borers' entry.

Mealybug.notes: knowledge/chilli_reference.txt has no Mealybug entry (the 'Pests of Economic Importance' list doesn't include it), so this entry was added separately using only well-established, generic mealybug facts (cottony masses, honeydew/sooty mould, sap-sucking) rather than the curated reference. No chemical dosage is given (management.chemical is null) since none is sourced from the reference. Telugu name reused 1:1 from model_info.json.

Red Mites.notes: Reference 'Mites' entry covers Polyphagotarsonemus latus, Tarsonemus translucens, and Tetranychus cinnabarinus generally; model class is specifically 'Red Mites' (likely T. cinnabarinus). Telugu name reused 1:1 from model_info.json.

Beet Armyworm.notes: Mapped to the Spodoptera exigua component of the reference's combined 'Pod Borers' entry.

Tobacco Caterpillar.notes: Mapped to the Spodoptera litura component of the reference's combined 'Pod Borers' entry.
